question.knowledge_point: Finding an Entry of a Square Matrix
question.problem:
Find the entry ${r}_{43}$ of the matrix $R$, where 

$$
R=[\begin{aligned}-5 & 2 & \sqrt{3} & 4 \\ -3 & 0 & -4 & 5 \\ 5 & -2 & 8 & -1 \\ 0 & -1 & 1 & \sqrt{2}\end{aligned}].
$$
question.worked_solution:
The entry ${r}_{43}$ lies at the intersection of the $4$th row and $3$rd column. Therefore, ${r}_{43}=1.$

$$
E=[\begin{aligned}-5 & 2 & \sqrt{3} & 4 \\ -3 & 0 & -4 & 5 \\ 5 & -2 & 8 & -1 \\ 0 & -1 & 1 & \sqrt{2}\end{aligned}]
$$
